topic: Testing analytics access for specific facilities
summary_markdown:
Someone instructed [p1] to log into the staging analytics environment (https://staging-analytics.allunite.com/) using an internal email address and test functionality.

The testing was designed to simulate a complex scenario: combining data from one cluster with screen captures from another cluster, which is intended to be challenging for the system.
[p1] reported that the platform behaved strangely during testing.
decisions: Testing access limitations were set on the staging analytics environment.
